Care suites containing sleeping rooms shall be not greater than 7,500 square feet (696 m 2 ) in area.
   Exception: Care suites containing sleeping rooms shall be permitted to be not greater than 10,000 square feet (929 m 2 ) in area where an automatic smoke detection system is provided throughout the care suite and installed in accordance with NFPA 72 as modified by Appendix Q of this code.
